Romanian only: stated_text is the Romanian text as converted, translation_en is a machine translation by the extracting agent, machine_translated is true, and evidence confidence is capped at Medium (extraction rules section 6). Treatment follows the G3 sample file for the 2025 report (MDA-GOV-2026-004) for consistency. Chapter 2 items (cluster 2, chapter 02) are those on displaced persons and refugees from Ukraine (foreign nationals' access to the labour market in Moldova), ANOFM agreements whose target groups include refugees or third-country nationals, the internal audit engagement on implementing the EURES network (page 26) and the EURES objective of the 2025 Plan. Theme items are online services used by jobseekers and employers (angajat.md visits and vacancy aggregation, the Cognitrom platform, the voucher platform), the Helvetas referral platform for refugees (chapter and theme, theme_doubtful) and the barrier on the lack of a modern information system. Left out: the 2024 Plan objectives (page 3: none concerns foreign workers, EURES or online services); nationals' emigration (consultations and online forms on legal employment abroad, registration of contracts for work abroad, the agreements with Israel, Germany and Bulgaria, pages 21) and returning migrants (page 22) as outside the Chapter 2 boundary; general labour market measures, target groups, training, subsidies, mobile teams and unemployment benefit; the call-centre count that mentions the employment of Ukrainian citizens among other topics (page 11) and the nine campaigns that list displaced persons from Ukraine among other groups (page 12), because the counts are not specific to them; the 08.02.2024 agreement with A.O. Help (page 24), stated as about safety, assistance and protection of refugees, not employment; the 09.02.2024 one-stop shop pilot of the labour ministry and CNAS (page 24); the transmission of unemployment benefit decisions to CNAS through secure intersystem connections (page 20), a back-office system; the ILO self-service spaces (pages 3 and 24), not described as digital, and the internal e-learning platform (pages 4 and 24-25); the automated monitoring of active measures and the eTicket helpdesk (page 25), internal systems; the amendment of the ANOFM organisation decision (GD 617/2024, page 26), which mentions European guidelines only in passing; the 2025 Plan objectives that mention online services only in passing (page 27). M3: the Helvetas platform, the angajat.md aggregation and the UNHCR campaign appear in the introduction (page 4) with nearly identical wording and are extracted once, at the detailed section. Text problems: the list after "precum" at the foot of page 23 (ANOFM partnerships for displaced persons) is missing from the converted text, probably an image; several tables of figures by occupation and the list of measures for returning migrants are not in the text. For the analyst: whether the Helvetas referral platform (-0018) meets the TECH-DGOV test, and whether the EURES audit engagement (-0020) is better typed as a finding. ANOFM, STOFM, Helvetas, NRC and the Congress of Ukrainians have no actor records; actor_id is null. items.stated_text: A fost elaborată platforma Voucher pentru formarea profesională a șomerilor. Platforma va simplifica semnificativ procesul de obținere a unui voucher la serviciile de formare profesională, proces care va digitaliza procesul cap-coadă. Platforma va permite emiterea voucherelor utilizând resursele electronice, înregistrarea și validarea prestatorilor de servicii de formare, crearea electronică a grupelor de studii, precum și administrarea acestora.
items.translation_en: The Voucher platform for the vocational training of the unemployed was developed. The platform will significantly simplify the process of obtaining a voucher for vocational training services, which will digitalise the process end to end. The platform will allow vouchers to be issued using electronic resources, training providers to be registered and validated, study groups to be created electronically, and their administration.
items.summary: ANOFM developed a voucher platform for unemployed people's training, to digitalise voucher issuing, provider registration and study groups end to end.
